arxiv-1911-08031.title: The Design and Implementation of a Scalable DL Benchmarking Platform
arxiv-1911-08031.creator: Cheng Li, Abdul Dakkak, Jinjun Xiong, Wen-mei Hwu
arxiv-1911-08031.description: Abstract . The current Deep Learning (DL) landscape is fast-paced and is rife with non-uniform models, hardware/software (HW/SW) stacks, but lacks a DL benchmarking platform to facilitate evaluation and comparison of DL innovations, be it models, frameworks, libraries, or hardware.

arxiv-2012-08371.title: Limiting laws and consistent estimation criteria for fixed and diverging number of spiked eigenvalues
arxiv-2012-08371.creator: Jianwei Hu, Jingfei Zhang, Jianhua Guo and Ji Zhu, Department of Statistics, Central China Normal University, Wuhan, China, Goizueta Business School, Emory University, Atlanta, GA, USA, School of Mathematics, Statistics, Beijing Technology, Business University, Beijing, China, Department of Statisti
arxiv-2012-08371.description: Abstract In this paper, we study limiting laws and consistent estimation criteria for the extreme eigenvalues in a spiked covariance model of dimension p p with the number of spikes k k . Allowing both p p and k k to diverge, we derive limiting distributions of the spiked sample eigenvalues using random matrix theory techniques.

arxiv-2104-08263.title: The String Dual to Free 𝒩 = 4 {\cal N}=4 Super Yang-Mills
arxiv-2104-08263.creator: ​​​​ Matthias R. Gaberdiel a and Rajesh Gopakumar b a Institut für Theoretische Physik, ETH Zürich Wolfgang-Pauli-Straße 27, 8093 Zürich, Switzerland b International Centre for Theoretical Sciences (ICTS-TIFR), Shivakote, Hesaraghatta Hobli, Bangalore North, India 560 089
arxiv-2104-08263.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by ​​​​ Matthias R. Gaberdiel a and Rajesh Gopakumar b a Institut für Theoretische Physik, ETH Zürich Wolfgang-Pauli-Straße 27, 8093 Zürich, Switzerland b International Centre for Theoretical Sciences (ICTS-TIFR), Shivakote, Hesaraghatta Hobli, Bangalore North, India 560 089. We propose a worldsheet description for the AdS 5 × S 5 {\rm AdS}_{5}\times{\rm S}^{5} string theory dual to large N N , free 𝒩 = 4 {\cal N}=4 super Yang-Mills in four dimensions.

arxiv-2105-13701.title: Marginally-Stable Thermal Equilibria of Rayleigh-Bénard Convection
arxiv-2105-13701.creator: Liam O’Connor 1, Daniel Lecoanet 1,2, Evan H. Anders 2
arxiv-2105-13701.description: Abstract Natural convection exhibits turbulent flows which are difficult or impossible to resolve in direct numerical simulations. In this work, we investigate a quasilinear form of the Rayleigh-Bénard problem which describes the bulk one-dimensional properties of convection without resolving the turbulent dynamics. We represent perturbations away from the mean using a sum of marginally-stable eigenmodes.

arxiv-2108-09112.title: Continual Learning for Image-Based Camera Localization
arxiv-2108-09112.creator: Shuzhe Wang, Zakaria Laskar, Iaroslav Melekhov, Xiaotian Li, Juho Kannala
arxiv-2108-09112.description: Abstract For several emerging technologies such as augmented reality, autonomous driving and robotics, visual localization is a critical component. Directly regressing camera pose/3D scene coordinates from the input image using deep neural networks has shown great potential. However, such methods assume a stationary data distribution with all scenes simultaneously available during training.

arxiv-2210-09206.title: Model Predictive Control via On-Policy Imitation Learning
arxiv-2210-09206.creator: Kwangjun Ahn, Zakaria Mhammedi, Horia Mania, Zhang-Wei Hong, Ali Jadbabaie
arxiv-2210-09206.description: Abstract In this paper, we leverage the rapid advances in imitation learning , a topic of intense recent focus in the Reinforcement Learning (RL) literature, to develop new sample complexity results and performance guarantees for data-driven Model Predictive Control (MPC) for constrained linear systems.

arxiv-2309-10496.title: Note on general functional flows in equilibrium systems
arxiv-2309-10496.creator: Kiyoharu Kawana
arxiv-2309-10496.description: Abstract We study the response of generating functionals to a variation of parameters (couplings) in equilibrium systems i.e. in quantum field theory (QFT) and equilibrium statistical mechanics. These parameters can be either physical ones such as coupling constants or artificial ones which are intentionally introduced such as the renormalization scale in field theories.

arxiv-2310-01650.title: CoDBench : A Critical Evaluation of Data-driven Models for Continuous Dynamical Systems
arxiv-2310-01650.creator: Priyanshu Burark, Karn Tiwari, Prathosh A P, Meer Mehran Rashid, N M Anoop Krishnan
arxiv-2310-01650.description: Abstract Continuous dynamical systems, characterized by differential equations, are ubiquitously used to model several important problems: plasma dynamics, flow through porous media, weather forecasting, and epidemic dynamics. Recently, a wide range of data-driven models has been used successfully to model these systems.

arxiv-2404-02567.title: Fusing Multi-sensor Input with State Information on TinyML Brains for Autonomous Nano-drones
arxiv-2404-02567.creator: Luca Crupi 1, Elia Cereda 1, Daniele Palossi 12
arxiv-2404-02567.description: Abstract Autonomous nano-drones ( ∼ \sim 10 cm 10\text{\,}\mathrm{cm} in diameter), thanks to their ultra-low power TinyML-based brains, are capable of coping with real-world environments. However, due to their simplified sensors and compute units, they are still far from the sense-and-act capabilities shown in their bigger counterparts.

arxiv-2508-20122.title: Spatio-Temporal Pruning for Compressed Spiking Large Language Models
arxiv-2508-20122.creator: Yi Jiang 1 , Malyaban Bal 1 , Brian Matejek 2 , Susmit Jha 2 , Adam Cobb 2 , Abhronil Sengupta 1
arxiv-2508-20122.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) present significant challenges for deployment in energy-constrained environments due to their large model sizes and high inference latency. Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs), inspired by the sparse event-driven neural processing and energy-efficient information transmission in the brain, offer a promising alternative for achieving low-power computing.

arxiv-2601-19528.title: High-sensitivity silicon nitride microring resonator opto-fluidic sensor
arxiv-2601-19528.creator: D.O. Armstrong, S. Ibrahim, S. Naserikarimvand, S. Whelan, O.J. Guy, A.J. Bennett, J.P. Hadden
arxiv-2601-19528.description: Abstract Photonic integrated circuit devices can be used as refractometric opto-fluidic sensors to detect the presence of analytes in solution at low concentrations. In this work, we investigate the refractive index sensitivity of silicon nitride microring resonator based photonic integrated circuit fluidic sensors.

pmc-10559623.title: Resistance training alters body composition in middle-aged women depending on menopause - A 20-week control trial
pmc-10559623.creator: Eduard Isenmann, Dominik Kaluza, Tim Havers, Ana Elbeshausen, Stephan Geisler, Katharina Hofmann, Ulrich Flenker, Patrick Diel, Simon Gavanda
pmc-10559623.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundResistance training (RT) is effective in counteracting the age- and menopause-related loss of muscle mass (MM) and strength in middle-aged women (40–60 years). Research on RT with free weights is limited in pre- and post-menopausal women. Based on this, a 20-week training intervention was conducted with this population to investigate the effects of systematic RT with free weights on strength capacity and body composition.MethodForty-one healthy women (52.0 ± 3.6 years) participated in this study.

pmc-10736547.title: FOSTERING CONSISTENT AND ENGAGING CARE FOR PEOPLE WITH DEMENTIA IN LONG-TERM CARE
pmc-10736547.creator: Jennifer Morgan, Candace Kemp, Andrea Hill, Alexis Bender
pmc-10736547.description: Maintaining a stable and qualified direct care workforce in long-term care organizations has become increasingly difficult as shortages intensify, turnover increases, and the use of agency staff remains at high levels. Efforts to improve this situation need to include high quality training that is incorporated into onboarding, ongoing continuing education, and infused into the culture of the organization.

pmc-11513732.title: Nivolumab plus chemotherapy in patients with HER2-negative, previously untreated, unresectable, advanced, or recurrent gastric/gastroesophageal junction cancer: 3-year follow-up of the ATTRACTION-4 randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, phase 3 trial
pmc-11513732.creator: Narikazu Boku, Takeshi Omori, Kohei Shitara, Shinichi Sakuramoto, Kensei Yamaguchi, Ken Kato, Shigenori Kadowaki, Kunihiro Tsuji, Min-Hee Ryu, Do-Youn Oh, Sang Cheul Oh, Sun Young Rha, Keun-Wook Lee, Ik-Joo Chung, Sun Jin Sym, Li-Tzong Chen, Jen-Shi Chen, Li-Yuan Bai, Takashi Nakada, Shunsuke Hagiha
pmc-11513732.description: BackgroundNivolumab + chemotherapy is now a standard of care for HER2-negative, previously untreated, unresectable or recurrent gastric/gastroesophageal junction cancer (advanced gastric cancer), but long-term follow-up data of clinical trials are limited.MethodsATTRACTON-4 was a phase 3, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial in Japan, South Korea, and Taiwan.

pmc-11575127.title: Availability, price, and affordability of diabetes mellitus and thyroid dysfunction medicines in South Wollo zone, Northeast Ethiopia
pmc-11575127.creator: Solomon Ahmed Mohammed, Haile Yirga Mengesha, Abel Andualem, Elham Seid, Getnet Mengistu Assefa
pmc-11575127.description: BackgroundDiabetes mellitus and thyroid dysfunction are prevalent endocrine disorders that impose enormous burdens on patients and countries. However, access to essential medicines remains inadequate in many low-income countries. This study evaluated medications’ availability, price, and affordability for these conditions.MethodsA cross-sectional study was conducted at health facilities in the South Wollo zone in 2022.

pmc-12610076.title: Green Valorization Strategies of Pleurotus ostreatus and Its By-Products: A Critical Review of Emerging Technologies and Sustainable Applications
pmc-12610076.creator: Pablo Ayuso, Jhazmin Quizhpe, Rocío Peñalver, Pascual García-Pérez, Gema Nieto
pmc-12610076.description: Pleurotus ostreatus, commonly known as the oyster mushroom, is a widely cultivated edible mushroom characterized by its nutritional value and health benefits. However, its large-scale production generates significant amounts of agro-industrial by-products, such as stipes, residual mycelium, and spent mushroom substrate (SMS).

pmc-12650973.title: Artificial Intelligence in Endodontic Education: A Systematic Review with Frequentist and Bayesian Meta-Analysis of Student-Based Evidence
pmc-12650973.creator: Carlos M Ardila, Eliana Pineda-Vélez, Anny M Vivares-Builes, Amer Sehic, Qalbi Khan
pmc-12650973.description: Background/Objectives: Artificial intelligence (AI) is entering dental curricula, yet its educational value in endodontics remains unclear. This review synthesized student-based evidence on AI in endodontics, primarily comparing AI vs. students on diagnostic tasks as an educational endpoint and secondarily considering assessment tasks relevant to training. Methods: PubMed/MEDLINE, Embase, Scopus, and Web of Science were searched in July 2025.

pmc-13112197.title: Priorities for medication management information resources for people with dementia and carers: a community-driven approach using a modified Delphi method
pmc-13112197.creator: Jacqueline Wesson, Amanda J Cross, Karen Watson, Natali Jokanovic, Carl Schneider, Ardalan Mirzaei, Joanne Chung Man Lo, Mouna Sawan
pmc-13112197.description: BackgroundManaging medications safely can be challenging for people with dementia and carers living in the community and medication errors can be a source of preventable harm. Resources to support people in medication management must address their information needs and prioritise these alongside those of broader stakeholders.

pmc-13413391.title: Should Schlemm Canal-Based MIGS Be Combined with Cataract Surgery in Patients Receiving Topical Glaucoma Therapy? A Cataract Surgeon-Oriented Review
pmc-13413391.creator: Suguru Nakagawa, Toshikatsu Kaburaki, Kiyoshi Ishii
pmc-13413391.description: Background/Objectives: Schlemm canal-based minimally invasive glaucoma surgery (MIGS) can be combined with cataract surgery, but topical glaucoma therapy alone is not a sufficient indication for adding MIGS. This review addresses when cataract surgery alone may be sufficient, when combined cataract surgery and MIGS may be appropriate, and when filtration surgery should be considered.

pmc-13669929.title: Anomalous Origin of the Right Coronary Artery From the Pulmonary Artery
pmc-13669929.creator: Abdullah Muhammad-Nasser, Graham Seibel, Mariam Riad, Steven Billingsley, Thomas Skelton, Nasser Moiduddin, William Campbell

Patient 1 is a 57-year-old woman who presented to the cardiology clinic for episodes of palpitations and dizziness associated with dyspnea on minimal exertion.
